flow.name: patient-exp-api-main
flow.doc:description: Portal entry point: correlation ID, spec validation, routing to an operation flow

http:listener.doc:name: Listener /api/*
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts portal requests; every response carries X-Correlation-ID

flow-ref.name: start-request-context
flow-ref.doc:name: Start request context
flow-ref.doc:description: Accepts the caller's X-Correlation-ID or uses a generated UUID; logs the request

apikit:router.doc:name: APIkit router
apikit:router.doc:description: Rejects requests that do not match the portal contract and dispatches the rest

flow-ref.name: log-response-sent
flow-ref.doc:name: Log response sent
flow-ref.doc:description: Logs the response status and request duration

flow.name: post:\patients:application\json:patient-exp-api-config
flow.doc:name: POST /patients
flow.doc:description: Forwards the portal registration with channel PORTAL and returns the portal view

ee:transform.doc:name: Add channel PORTAL
ee:transform.doc:description: Passes the portal request on unchanged, adding channel PORTAL

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toProcessRegistration from dwl::PortalView output application/json --- toProcessRegistration(payload)

flow-ref.name: create-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: Register via Process API
flow-ref.doc:description: Registers the patient through the Process API (never retried)

flow-ref.name: to-portal-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: To portal view
flow-ref.doc:description: Shapes the registered patient for the portal

set-variable.doc:name: Location header
set-variable.doc:description: Points the Location header at the new patient resource

flow.name: get:\patients\(patientId):patient-exp-api-config
flow.doc:name: GET /patients/{patientId}
flow.doc:description: Reads one patient through the Process API and returns the portal view

set-variable.doc:name: Patient ID
set-variable.doc:description: Reads the patient ID from the URI

flow-ref.name: get-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: Get patient via Process API
flow-ref.doc:description: Reads the patient through the Process API, retrying transient failures

flow-ref.name: to-portal-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: To portal view
flow-ref.doc:description: Shapes the patient for the portal

sub-flow.name: to-portal-patient
sub-flow.doc:description: Process API patient to the portal's flat view with full name and age on the day of the request

ee:transform.doc:name: Patient to portal view
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds fullName and calculates age today in the clinic time zone

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import toPortalPatient, todayIn from dwl::PortalView output application/json --- toPortalPatient(payload, todayIn(p('clinic.timeZone')))
